title: Beginner's Guide to Acro Dance: Master Your First Moves! 🤸 | Cirque du Soleil

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions for each component of the move. He emphasizes the importance of proper technique and safety while encouraging students to work at their own pace.

lesson_structure.note: The teachers introduce themselves and the dance style.
The teachers demonstrate a ball, seal stretch, cat stretch, and bridge.
The teacher breaks down the front walkover into four steps.
The teachers perform a short combo incorporating the front walkover.

metaphors: Imagine your spine going all the way up
Push your pelvis to the ceiling
safety: Don't try to go over yet
You don't have to be the most flexible person

steps_taught.name: Handstand
steps_taught.description: A handstand with a tight core and strong arms.

steps_taught.name: Kick to a bridge
steps_taught.description: A handstand that transitions into a bridge.

steps_taught.name: Rock to stand up
steps_taught.description: Rocking back and forth in a bridge to gain momentum to stand up.

steps_taught.name: Split your legs
steps_taught.description: Splitting the legs to create the momentum for the front walkover.

what_works: The breakdown of the move into four distinct steps
The use of a demonstrator to show the moves
what_hinders: The lack of slow-motion replays for the more complex steps

quotes.text: I'm going to teach you step-by-step how to incorporate this and use this.
Remember, you don't have to think about all the arch back.
You don't have to be the most flexible person in your bridge.
You don't want to always think that you need to have a flexible back.
Don't try to go over yet, come down, tuck and roll.

evidence_segments.observation: The demonstrator performs a ball, tuck, and roll on the floor.
The demonstrator performs a seal stretch on the floor.
The demonstrator performs a cat stretch on the floor.
The demonstrator performs a bridge on the floor.
The demonstrator performs a kick to a bridge.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a 'step-by-step' approach, breaking down the move into four distinct components and then combining them.
